usage: Protocol reference only. The TypeScript implementation reuses Node Comics' existing Comici catalog, search, canvas and image modules; upstream Kotlin/APK code and downloaded source scripts are not executed or bundled.
scope: Public title-only search, numbered HTML catalogs, public episode JSON identity/access/contentId, contentsInfo viewer manifests and 4x4 column-major image permutations for Comic PASH, HERO'S Web, Comic RIDE, COMIC Ryu, Young Animal, Champion Cross, Young Champion, MangaBang, Hanayume, TakeComic, KimiComi and Asacomi. JSON catalog pagination, image-only episode content, account/JWT operations, unlock/purchase APIs, rankings and other upstream sites are not implemented or claimed compatible.

files.purpose: Public episode and contentsInfo endpoints, contentId and explicit chapter access; existing HTML catalogs are retained, without account or unlocking requests.
Reference for episode identity, series, summary, access, contentId and viewer content fields; not a complete DTO port.
Cross-check of the existing 4x4 column-major permutation; Node Comics retains its comici-v1 format and source-viewer transparent remainder behavior, not the upstream edge-copy implementation.
